organisation.technologies: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, REST/FHIR APIs, MongoDB/NoSQL, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Zustand, Material UI, Azure DevOps, Playwright, Jest, Datadog, Grafana, Postman

properties.details: Owned end-to-end delivery of complex healthcare modules, translating product requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, frontend/backend changes, tests, controlled releases, and production support.

Owned the Coverage/Insurance subsystem across patient and order workflows, building reusable React/TypeScript forms and hooks for add/edit/delete flows, validation, sequencing, insurance-card handling, permissions, and integrations across multiple product contexts.

Developed and integrated Node.js/Express REST APIs and backend service logic for healthcare workflows, supporting Patient, Order, Study, and scheduling-related operations while coordinating API contracts and data structures with frontend consumers.
Implemented asynchronous and event-driven integration patterns for scheduling and workflow updates using webhooks, supporting downstream synchronization and reliable UI/worklist refreshes.

Designed the frontend architecture for Order-Level Coverage and delivered a major Order Creation / Order Drawer revamp with dynamic multi-step forms, backend-driven state, conditional workflows, provider search, role-aware UI, and REST/FHIR integrations.

Consolidated duplicated implementations across product contexts into shared component, hook, and field architecture; built reusable Provider / Practitioner Organisation and form infrastructure to improve maintainability and extensibility.

Constructed and debugged FHIR/REST payloads for Patient, Coverage, ServiceRequest, and related resources; validated APIs in Postman and resolved HTTP, integration, and data-contract issues across application layers.
Built and maintained Playwright E2E coverage for critical healthcare workflows and supported unit testing, SonarQube quality gates, code reviews, and feature-flagged releases.

Used Azure DevOps for CI/CD build validation and failure diagnosis and Datadog/Grafana/Checkly for production diagnostics and operational visibility; reproduced pipeline/E2E failures locally and ran selective pipelines.
Participated in technical design, Jira-based Agile planning, task breakdown, documentation, and mentoring; used AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate implementation and testing.

properties.details: Started as the sole frontend engineer for a new TRC Healthcare internal dashboard, establishing the initial React application structure before later leading and mentoring two junior frontend developers.

Built the core application architecture including JWT authentication, role-based access, application layout, navigation, and global state management, supporting users with different and multiple access levels.

Selected Redux Toolkit as the primary state-management approach after technical evaluation and used it for authentication, user/access information, API data, caching, asynchronous flows, and global UI state.
Designed and implemented reusable, data-heavy UI functionality including sorting, search, pagination, row actions, conditional selection, and row/column drag-and-drop for Smart Table workflows.

Assigned frontend work, reviewed code, mentored junior developers, and collaborated with API engineers, QA, product stakeholders, and technical leadership to resolve integration issues and guide Agile delivery.

Developed React-based features for AIG insurance applications, including payment and filtering workflows, REST API integrations, responsive AEM pages, Jest unit tests, defect resolution, and code-coverage improvements.
